title: Weather
description: The station now and over the selected range: temperature, humidity, wind, rain, pressure and indoor readings. Each hour comes from the radio if it has any of it, else from the station's uploads (Weather Underground, then Weathercloud), so long ranges reach back to November 2021.

panels.title: Temperature
panels.description: The latest minute's average (within the last 30 minutes of the range).

targets.rawSql:
DECLARE @to datetime2 = $__timeTo();
SELECT TOP 1 TemperatureAvgC AS [Temperature] FROM dbo.Outdoor
WHERE TimeUtc <= @to AND TimeUtc > DATEADD(MINUTE, -30, @to) AND TemperatureAvgC IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY TimeUtc DESC

panels.title: Today: min / max
panels.description: Since midnight (UK time) of the range's last day.

panels.title: Humidity / dew point
panels.description: Relative humidity (%) and dew point (°C).

targets.rawSql:
DECLARE @to datetime2 = $__timeTo();
SELECT TOP 1 HumidityAvg AS [Humidity], DewPointC AS [Dew point] FROM dbo.Outdoor
WHERE TimeUtc <= @to AND TimeUtc > DATEADD(MINUTE, -30, @to) AND HumidityAvg > 0 AND TemperatureAvgC IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY TimeUtc DESC

panels.title: Wind / gust
panels.description: Average wind and strongest gust over the last 10 minutes of the range.

panels.title: Direction
panels.description: Where the wind is coming from: the speed-weighted mean over the last 10 minutes of the range.

targets.rawSql:
DECLARE @to datetime2 = $__timeTo();
SELECT CASE WHEN d < 0 THEN d + 360 ELSE d END AS [From]
FROM (
  SELECT DEGREES(ATN2(SUM(WindAvgMs * SIN(RADIANS(WindDirDeg))), SUM(WindAvgMs * COS(RADIANS(WindDirDeg))))) AS d
  FROM dbo.Outdoor
  WHERE TimeUtc <= @to AND TimeUtc > DATEADD(MINUTE, -10, @to) AND WindDirDeg IS NOT NULL
  HAVING SUM(WindAvgMs) > 0) AS w

panels.title: Rain: today / 24 h
panels.description: Since midnight (UK time), and over the last 24 hours of the range.

panels.title: Pressure
panels.description: The latest pressure (fetched from Weather Underground hourly, so up to an hour old) and how much it changed over the 3 hours before: falling pressure usually means unsettled weather is coming.

panels.title: Temperature
panels.description: The lowest and highest readings in the range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT MIN(TemperatureMinC) AS [Min], MAX(TemperatureMaxC) AS [Max] FROM dbo.Hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(HourUtc)

panels.title: Humidity
panels.description: The lowest and highest minute averages in the range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT MIN(HumidityMin) AS [Min], MAX(HumidityMax) AS [Max] FROM dbo.Hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(HourUtc) AND HumidityMin > 0

panels.title: Rain
panels.description: Total rain in the range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ISNULL(ROUND(SUM(RainMm), 1), 0) AS [Total] FROM dbo.Hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(HourUtc)

panels.title: Strongest wind / gust
panels.description: The highest minute-average wind and the strongest gust in the range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT MAX(WindMaxMs) * 2.23694 AS [Wind], MAX(GustMaxMs) * 2.23694 AS [Gust] FROM dbo.Hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(HourUtc)

panels.title: Pressure
panels.description: The lowest and highest pressure in the range, from the console (via Weather Underground, else Weathercloud). Up to the last hour: today is fetched from Weather Underground hourly.

targets.rawSql: SELECT MIN(PressureMinHpa) AS [Min], MAX(PressureMaxHpa) AS [Max] FROM dbo.Hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(HourUtc)

panels.title: Indoor
panels.description: The console's indoor temperature, lowest and highest in the range (from Weathercloud's exports, so up to the last one imported).

targets.rawSql: SELECT MIN(IndoorTemperatureMin) AS [Min], MAX(IndoorTemperatureMax) AS [Max] FROM dbo.Hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(HourUtc)

panels.title: Temperature
panels.description: Average per interval, with the range between the lowest and highest minute shaded, and the dew point.

targets.rawSql:
IF $__interval_ms >= 3600000
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(HourUtc, $__interval, NULL), MIN(TemperatureMinC) AS [Min], MAX(TemperatureMaxC) AS [Max], AVG(TemperatureAvgC) AS [Temperature], AVG(DewPointC) AS [Dew point]
FROM dbo.Hourly
WHERE $__timeFilter(HourUtc)
GROUP BY $__timeGroup(HourUtc, $__interval, NULL)
ORDER BY 1
ELSE
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(TimeUtc, $__interval, NULL), MIN(TemperatureMinC) AS [Min], MAX(TemperatureMaxC) AS [Max], AVG(TemperatureAvgC) AS [Temperature], AVG(CASE WHEN HumidityAvg > 0 THEN DewPointC END) AS [Dew point]
FROM dbo.Outdoor
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUtc)
GROUP BY $__timeGroup(TimeUtc, $__interval)
ORDER BY 1

IF $__interval_ms >= 3600000
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(HourUtc, $__interval, NULL), AVG(HumidityAvg) AS [Humidity]
FROM dbo.Hourly
WHERE $__timeFilter(HourUtc)
GROUP BY $__timeGroup(HourUtc, $__interval, NULL)
ORDER BY 1
ELSE
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(TimeUtc, $__interval, NULL), AVG(HumidityAvg) AS [Humidity]
FROM dbo.Outdoor
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUtc)
GROUP BY $__timeGroup(TimeUtc, $__interval)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Wind
panels.description: Average wind, and the strongest gust in each interval.

targets.rawSql:
IF $__interval_ms >= 3600000
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(HourUtc, $__interval, NULL), AVG(WindAvgMs) * 2.23694 AS [Wind], MAX(GustMaxMs) * 2.23694 AS [Gust]
FROM dbo.Hourly
WHERE $__timeFilter(HourUtc)
GROUP BY $__timeGroup(HourUtc, $__interval, NULL)
ORDER BY 1
ELSE
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(TimeUtc, $__interval, NULL), AVG(WindAvgMs) * 2.23694 AS [Wind], MAX(GustMaxMs) * 2.23694 AS [Gust]
FROM dbo.Outdoor
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUtc)
GROUP BY $__timeGroup(TimeUtc, $__interval)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Wind direction
panels.description: Where the wind came from: the speed-weighted mean direction in each interval (calm left out). 0/360 = north, 90 = east, 180 = south, 270 = west.

targets.rawSql:
IF $__interval_ms >= 3600000
SELECT time, CASE WHEN d < 0 THEN d + 360 ELSE d END AS [From]
FROM (
  SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(HourUtc, $__interval), DEGREES(ATN2(SUM(WindX), SUM(WindY))) AS d
  FROM dbo.Hourly
  WHERE $__timeFilter(HourUtc) AND WindX IS NOT NULL AND WindAvgMs >= 0.5
  GROUP BY $__timeGroup(HourUtc, $__interval)) AS w
ORDER BY 1
ELSE
SELECT time, CASE WHEN d < 0 THEN d + 360 ELSE d END AS [From]
FROM (
  SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(TimeUtc, $__interval),
         DEGREES(ATN2(SUM(WindAvgMs * SIN(RADIANS(WindDirDeg))), SUM(WindAvgMs * COS(RADIANS(WindDirDeg))))) AS d
  FROM dbo.Outdoor
  WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUtc) AND WindDirDeg IS NOT NULL AND WindAvgMs >= 0.5
  GROUP BY $__timeGroup(TimeUtc, $__interval)) AS w
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Rain
panels.description: Rain per hour, or per day or week on long ranges (the bars widen to fit).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(HourUtc, $__interval, 0), ROUND(SUM(RainMm), 1) AS [Rain]
FROM dbo.Hourly
WHERE $__timeFilter(HourUtc)
GROUP BY $__timeGroup(HourUtc, $__interval, 0)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Wind directions
panels.description: How often the wind came from each direction over the range: minutes with wind (calm left out), as a share of them.

targets.rawSql:
IF $__interval_ms >= 3600000
WITH points AS (SELECT * FROM (VALUES (0, 'N'), (1, 'NNE'), (2, 'NE'), (3, 'ENE'), (4, 'E'), (5, 'ESE'), (6, 'SE'), (7, 'SSE'), (8, 'S'), (9, 'SSW'), (10, 'SW'), (11, 'WSW'), (12, 'W'), (13, 'WNW'), (14, 'NW'), (15, 'NNW')) AS p (n, name)),
hours AS (
  SELECT CAST(ROUND((CASE WHEN d < 0 THEN d + 360 ELSE d END) / 22.5, 0) AS int) % 16 AS n
  FROM (SELECT DEGREES(ATN2(WindX, WindY)) AS d FROM dbo.Hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(HourUtc) AND WindAvgMs >= 0.5) AS h),
counts AS (SELECT n, COUNT(*) AS hours FROM hours GROUP BY n)
SELECT p.name AS [From], ISNULL(100.0 * c.hours / NULLIF(SUM(c.hours) OVER (), 0), 0) AS [Share]
FROM points p LEFT JOIN counts c ON c.n = p.n
ORDER BY p.n
ELSE
WITH points AS (SELECT * FROM (VALUES (0, 'N'), (1, 'NNE'), (2, 'NE'), (3, 'ENE'), (4, 'E'), (5, 'ESE'), (6, 'SE'), (7, 'SSE'), (8, 'S'), (9, 'SSW'), (10, 'SW'), (11, 'WSW'), (12, 'W'), (13, 'WNW'), (14, 'NW'), (15, 'NNW')) AS p (n, name)),
counts AS (
  SELECT CAST(ROUND(WindDirDeg / 22.5, 0) AS int) % 16 AS n, COUNT(*) AS minutes
  FROM dbo.Outdoor
  WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUtc) AND WindDirDeg IS NOT NULL AND WindAvgMs >= 0.5
  GROUP BY CAST(ROUND(WindDirDeg / 22.5, 0) AS int) % 16)
SELECT p.name AS [From], ISNULL(100.0 * c.minutes / NULLIF(SUM(c.minutes) OVER (), 0), 0) AS [Share]
FROM points p LEFT JOIN counts c ON c.n = p.n
ORDER BY p.n

panels.title: Pressure
panels.description: Sea-level pressure from the console, via Weather Underground (else Weathercloud). Up to the last hour: today is fetched from Weather Underground hourly.

targets.rawSql:
IF $__interval_ms >= 3600000
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(HourUtc, $__interval, NULL), AVG(PressureHpa) AS [Pressure]
FROM dbo.Hourly
WHERE $__timeFilter(HourUtc)
GROUP BY $__timeGroup(HourUtc, $__interval, NULL)
ORDER BY 1
ELSE
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(TimeUtc, $__interval, NULL), AVG(PressureHpa) AS [Pressure]
FROM dbo.Pressure
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUtc)
GROUP BY $__timeGroup(TimeUtc, $__interval)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Indoor
panels.description: The console's indoor temperature and humidity, from Weathercloud's exports (up to the last one imported).

targets.rawSql:
IF $__interval_ms >= 3600000
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(HourUtc, $__interval, NULL), AVG(IndoorTemperatureC) AS [Temperature], AVG(IndoorHumidity) AS [Humidity]
FROM dbo.Hourly
WHERE $__timeFilter(HourUtc)
GROUP BY $__timeGroup(HourUtc, $__interval, NULL)
ORDER BY 1
ELSE
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(TimeUtc, $__interval, NULL), AVG(TemperatureC) AS [Temperature], AVG(Humidity) AS [Humidity]
FROM dbo.Indoor
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUtc)
GROUP BY $__timeGroup(TimeUtc, $__interval)
ORDER BY 1
